remarks: Welcome to this charming 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom single story home, 5 minutes from Willow Springs International Raceway! It has a comfortable living space, nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac that is the gateway to a beautiful open desert. This home is an off-road enthusiast's dream! Enjoy easy access to wide open desert terrain, perfect for dirt biking, ATV riding, four-wheeling  &  endless outdoor adventures half a block from your doorstep! Enjoy a private front porch area where you can sip your morning coffee or enjoy a weekend outdoor barbeque.
